title: Evidence Persistence Without Raw Redistribution
pass_conditions: authoritative source is publicly and reproducibly accessible
no authentication, paid entitlement, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, privileged session, or prohibited access mechanism is required
repository can persist sufficient bounded audit evidence without full raw-source redistribution
future canonical rows can be traced to the official source contract
complete raw-source redistribution is not technically required for deterministic audit or reproduction
bounded review discovers no explicit official statement blocking the specific project behavior required for canonical metadata

provenance_time_rule.when_no_explicit_as_of: use deterministic source snapshot identifier such as SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_SHA256:<sha256>; preserve Source_Retrieved_UTC separately

scope: forward authority; does not rewrite historical G-SEC-01/G-SEC-02/G-SEC-03/G-SEC-04 evidence
